sloka: संक्षेपः ते एष मे राम किम् उक्त्वा विस्तरम् हि ते ।स मे ज्येष्ठो रिपुः भ्राता वाली विश्रुत पौरुषः ॥४-८-३८॥
transliteration: saṁkṣepaḥ te eṣa me rāma kim uktvā vistaram hi te ।sa me jyeṣṭho ripuḥ bhrātā vālī viśruta pauruṣaḥ ॥4-8-38॥

translations.english: 'O Rama I tell you (my story) briefly. It is not necessary to go into details. My elder brother Vali, who is known for his prowess, is my enemy.
